name: VV: ULTIMATUM [EARLY ACCESS]
desc:
A stylized fighting game in which you navigate dangerous worlds, protect and serve your chosen faction, and engage in thrilling combat with strange monsters and ancient threats. With over 130 skills and abilities to choose from, developing a character uniquely tailored to your play style has never been easier.
